applies_to: Armstrong HumidiClean HC-6100, HC-6300, HC-6500 and HC-6700 ionic bed electric steam humidifiers with the FieldServer ProtoNode BACnet gateway.
summary: The HumidiClean HC-6000 speaks Modbus RTU natively; BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP comes through a FieldServer ProtoNode gateway set up with the HC6000 profile. The BACnet list has binary inputs for valves and contactors, binary values for sensor options, analog inputs for status, run timers and temperatures, and analog values for set points, timers, run mode and network control level.
notes: Source: Table 49-1 'BACnet Variant List', manual page 50 (59 objects). The table gives only a description per object, not a BACnet object name, so the description is used as the name here. Object names on a real ProtoNode gateway may differ; match points by type and instance.
AV 21-26 are marked debug only in the manual.
Times are split across two objects (hours part and minutes part), e.g. AI 5/6 bed life and AI 7/8 run time.
The ProtoNode gateway's default IP is 192.168.1.24; its DIP switches select the profile (PSP or Modbus RTU to BACnet IP/MS/TP HC6000).
The manual prints no revision date; 2023-04 is inferred from the '539D-EN V2.1 4-23' code on the back cover.

source.title: HumidiClean Humidifiers Series HC-6100/6300/6500/6700 - Installation, Operation and Maintenance Instructions

integration.summary: Connect the ProtoNode gateway, pick the HC6000 BACnet profile in its web configurator and give it the humidifier's Modbus node ID. On the humidifier set Network Control to the level the BMS needs. To run the unit from a BMS demand, enable the network, set Sensor Select (BV 2) to humidistat and write 0-100 % demand. Monitor run status, steam output, water level and the failure code.

minimum_points.why: Run mode: 0 steam gen, 3 unit stop

minimum_points.why: Set point or demand in use

integration.enable: In the humidifier Setup menu set Network Control to Monitor, Hstat (local humidistat), Sensor (local sensors) or Full; only Full lets the network make all control changes. For BMS demand control the manual says to verify the network is enabled and Sensor Select is humidistat, then write the 0-100 % demand.
integration.remote_sensors: The BMS can send a 0-100 % demand instead of a local humidistat or RH sensor. The manual says to write it to a BACnet analog output; the BACnet table itself has no AO, and the matching Modbus register (40002) is 'Set RH / Demand', which is AV 2 here.
setup: ProtoNode gateway default IP 192.168.1.24/24; configure through its web configurator (Protocol Selector, then add the HC6000 profile with the humidifier's node ID).
Humidifier Modbus side: Comm Address default 1, 9600 baud, even parity, Network Mode = Modbus.
Set 'BACnet Virtual Server Nodes' to Yes only when several humidifiers share one ProtoNode.
gotchas: The table lists failure codes 1-10 for AI 18 but prints no code for the no-failure state.
AV 21-26 are debug/test timers; don't write them in normal operation.
Timer values come as hour and minute pairs (e.g. AI 7 + AI 8); combine them for a total time.
